# Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering (BIPE)

> BIPE (Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering) is an AICTE-approved
> polytechnic in Phoolpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Founded in 2010
> by Purwanchal Educational Trust. JEECUP institute code: 4455.
> AICTE Permanent ID: 1-488233171. BTEUP-affiliated. AISHE-registered.
> Annual tuition: ₹30,150 (AFRC-approved). Catchment: Eastern Uttar
> Pradesh + Bihar.

## Core Facts

- Full name: Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering
- Short name: BIPE
- JEECUP code: 4455
- AICTE Permanent ID: 1-488233171
- AICTE EoA 2026-27: F.No. Northern/1-46216893240/2026/EOA dated 16 March 2026
- BTEUP affiliation: active (College Code 4455)
- AISHE: registered with the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
- Founded: 2010 (Purwanchal Educational Trust)
- Director: Prof. (Dr.) S. P. Tewari — appointed August 2026. Formerly
  Professor of Mechanical Engineering at IIT (BHU) Varanasi, where he
  taught for 38 years (1981-2019). Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering
  (Welding); Fellow of the Institution of Engineers (India). Guided
  8 Ph.D. scholars and 40 M.Tech dissertations; 56 research papers;
  5 books.
- Chairman: Dr. Chandrika Rai, IPS (Retd.), Purwanchal Educational Trust
- Principal: Rahul Srivastava, M.Tech
- Campus: Gajokhar, Phoolpur, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh 221206
- Campus size: 6 acres, single boundary
- Total sanctioned seats: 480
- Faculty: 40 (1:20 mentor ratio, with parent home visits)
- Alumni network: 2,200+ · 1,331 TPO-verified placements (2016-2025)
- Annual tuition (all branches): ₹30,150 (AFRC-approved)
- Hostel: boys' on-campus block — ₹12,000/year accommodation, mess charged
  separately. No girls' hostel yet (on the trust's roadmap); girl students
  attend as day scholars and admissions assists families with safe local
  accommodation.
- Catchment districts: Varanasi, Mau, Ghazipur, Jaunpur, Bhadohi, Azamgarh,
  Chandauli, Mirzapur, Sonbhadra, Ballia, Gorakhpur, Kushinagar, Pratapgarh,
  Sultanpur (Eastern UP) + Buxar, Bhojpur, Rohtas, Kaimur, Patna, Gaya,
  Aurangabad, Bhagalpur (Bihar)

## Programmes (5 BTEUP-affiliated diploma branches)

- [Computer Science & Engineering](https://bipevns.org/courses/computer-science-engineering): BTEUP code 355, 60 seats
- [Dairy Engineering](https://bipevns.org/courses/dairy-engineering): BTEUP code 327, 60 seats —
  rare: only ~4 institutes in UP offer this; careers at Amul, Mother Dairy,
  Parag, Nestlé, NDDB
- [Civil Engineering](https://bipevns.org/courses/civil-engineering): BTEUP code 322, 120 seats
- [Electrical Engineering](https://bipevns.org/courses/electrical-engineering): BTEUP code 328, 120 seats
- [Mechanical Engineering (Production)](https://bipevns.org/courses/mechanical-engineering-production): BTEUP code 343, 120 seats

All programmes: 3 years · 6 semesters · eligibility Class 10 pass with
Mathematics and Science (Group K lateral entry joins the 2nd year directly —
see Admissions).

## Admissions

Admission exclusively via JEECUP (UPJEE Polytechnic) counselling — institute
code 4455. Group A is the entrance for the 3-year diploma (Class 10 pass
with Mathematics and Science); Group K lateral entry admits Class 12 / ITI
candidates directly into the 2nd year (two-year route).
Apply at https://jeecup.admissions.nic.in — choose institute code 4455.

Bihar candidates: JEECUP admits other-state candidates in the open/general
category (no UP-domicile requirement), so Bihar students who appear for
DCECE/BCECE are eligible to simultaneously apply via JEECUP and choose
BIPE 4455. BIPE is 2–3 hours by road from the Bihar border districts —
Buxar ~85 km, Bhojpur (Ara) ~135 km, Rohtas (Sasaram) ~145 km.

## Placements

1,331 TPO-verified placements 2016-2025 across 47 documented drives and
44 recruiters. Current recruiters include: Mahindra · Krishna Maruti ·
JCB · Asian Paints · Adani Solar · Ola Electric · RR Parkon ·
Knorr Bremse · BD Group Campa · Amber · Hollister. Top single recruiter
on record: Vikas Group (202 placements). Dairy career pathways: Amul,
Mother Dairy, Parag, Nestlé, NDDB. Government pathways: Indian Railways
ALP, UPPCL, SSC JE, UP Police.
